title: Vibe Coding for Product Managers: Build What Engineering Won't Prioritize
summary: Product managers don't need to learn to code. They need to build working prototypes, dashboards, and team tools—without waiting for engineering. Here's exactly how vibe coding changes the PM workflow.
body_markdown: Yes — and that's the point. You're not trying to ship the prototype. You're using it to arrive at engineering handoff with a complete spec. The prototype eliminates the ambiguity that causes back-and-forth. Engineers stop asking "what did you mean by this?" because they can see exactly what you meant.
